items.statement: Promoter sold 75,000 shares after warrant conversion; no further dilution expected
items.quote: there was a converted allotted warrant and the promoter sold some 75,000 shares in the open market.

items.statement: Management confirms no dilution going forward from promoter
items.quote: No, there will be no dilution going forward.

items.statement: Promoter sold 75,000 shares after warrant conversion; no further dilution planned
items.quote: No, there will be no dilution going forward.

items.statement: Operational cash flow is positive at INR70-75 crores year-to-date despite P&L loss from accounting adjustment
items.quote: I can say that this year itself, our cash flow itself is around INR70 crores-INR75 crores till date, which is there.

items.statement: Operating cash flows have been negative historically due to industry nature and margin pressure but improving significantly this year
items.quote: It is partly a nature of the industry, the nature of our assignments. The competition has been pretty tough when it comes to margins now, especially in case of the PMC assignments that are there.

items.statement: No audit qualifications in limited review report; clean auditor report justifies no structural problems
items.quote: There have been no items of qualification also that have been mentioned by the auditors. It is a clean report and that itself justifies that there is no problem that has been going on in the company.

items.statement: Management strengthened internal controls, hired senior finance talent, and building leadership pipeline to improve governance after accounting adjustment and debarment issues
items.quote: We have strengthened our internal control systems. We have hired very strong accounting finance through -- be it SAP accounting, be it hiring from the bigger companies and further management is getting involved in creating second line, third line leaders also, so that there is stronger governance internally.

items.statement: Merger of Markolines Infra into Markolines Pavement announced with effective date January 1, 2026; detailed scheme to be filed in 10-15 days and approval expected in 6-9 months.
